summary.text: Thuy Tran is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 45 in Northeast and Southeast Portland who has served since January 9, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An optometrist and Lieutenant Colonel in the Oregon Air National Guard, she runs her own clinic in Northeast Portland.

paragraphs.text: Thuy Tran earned a B.S. in biology from the University of California, Los Angeles in 1990, a doctor of optometry from Pacific University in 1994, and an M.B.A. from George Fox University in 2016.

Her career includes owning Rose City Vision Care, serving on the board of the Parkrose School District and of Family Forward Oregon, and serving in the Oregon Air National Guard, where she reached the rank of Lieutenant Colonel.
Ballotpedia also lists her as a Lions Club member and a past president and vice president of the Vietnamese Community of Oregon.
Tran took office in the Oregon House in 2023, succeeding Barbara Smith Warner.

On her legislative website, she says she chaired the House Committee on Emergency Management, General Government, and Veterans during the 2025 session, also served on the Judiciary and Conduct committees, and serves as House co-chair of the Oregon Veterans Caucus.
